# ============================================================
# Quark Dairy — robots.txt
# Domain: https://www.quarkdairy.cn
# Updated: 2026-10-23
#
# Notes:
#   - Pre-rendered SPA: client routes (/, /products, /products/:id, /solutions,
#     /cases/:id, /about, /contact, /privacy, /terms and their /zh/* twins) each
#     have their OWN static file at dist/<path>/index.html, generated by
#     scripts/prerender.mjs after every build. Caddy serves them directly via
#     `try_files {path} {path}/index.html /index.html`.
#   - Admin/API/Uploads: explicitly disallowed.
#   - i18n: EN lives at the bare path (/products), ZH under the /zh prefix
#     (/zh/products). Both are real crawlable URLs, announced with hreflang
#     (en / zh-CN / x-default) from every page's <head> and listed in
#     sitemap.xml. Do NOT Disallow /zh — that would hide the Chinese site.
#
# ⚠️ Pre-rendering is the load-bearing part, robots.txt is NOT:
#   The site ships a React SPA, and crawlers that do NOT execute JavaScript
#   (DeepSeek Fetch, Baiduspider, 360Spider, most AI search engines) can only
#   read the static HTML. DeepSeek's Fetch API documents "no extractable
#   Markdown body" as an explicit 404 condition — so without pre-rendered HTML
#   every route 404s for them no matter what this file says.
#   Pre-rendering is wired into `npm run build`; if you ever build WITHOUT it
#   (`npm run build:noprerender`) and deploy, this site silently disappears from
#   those engines again. Verify with:
#     VERIFY_BASE=https://www.quarkdairy.cn VERIFY_FULL=1 npm run verify:prerender
#   See VISUAL-SPEC.md 附录 B.7.
# ============================================================

# Apply to all well-behaved crawlers (Googlebot, Bingbot, Baiduspider, YandexBot, DuckDuckBot, ...)
User-agent: *

# ---- Disallowed: backend & admin areas ----
# Admin panel — exposes inquiry data (PII)
Disallow: /admin

# Backend API endpoints — never crawl these
Disallow: /api/

# User-uploaded files (inquiry photos) — contain PII, never index
Disallow: /uploads/

# ---- Allowed: all public SPA routes ----
# (Implicit: everything not disallowed is allowed. Explicit Allow: / for clarity.)
Allow: /

# ---- Sitemap location ----
Sitemap: https://www.quarkdairy.cn/sitemap.xml

# ============================================================
# AI Crawler Policy — explicitly ALLOWED (B2B lead-gen site: we want AI
# search engines to be able to quote our product pages to their users).
#
# NOTE the repetition of the three Disallow lines in every block. A named
# User-agent group does NOT inherit the `User-agent: *` rules, so each group
# has to restate them or it would gain access to /admin, /api/ and /uploads/.
# ============================================================

# ---- AI search / retrieval bots (these bring traffic) ----
User-agent: DeepSeekBot
User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
User-agent: ChatGPT-User
User-agent: Claude-SearchBot
User-agent: Claude-User
User-agent: PerplexityBot
User-agent: Perplexity-User
User-agent: Google-Extended
User-agent: Bytespider
User-agent: Applebot-Extended
User-agent: YouBot
Allow: /
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /uploads/

# ---- AI training crawlers ----
# Currently allowed (same reasoning). To opt out of training while keeping
# AI search visibility, uncomment the Disallow line under each bot below —
# they are grouped with the search bots above, so change the matching group.
#
# GPTBot        → in the group above; add "Disallow: /"
# ClaudeBot     → not listed (falls back to *); add its own block to block
# CCBot         → not listed (falls back to *); add its own block to block

# ---- Chinese search engines (no JS execution — pre-rendering required) ----
User-agent: Baiduspider
User-agent: 360Spider
User-agent: Sogou web spider
User-agent: YandexBot
User-agent: DuckDuckBot
Allow: /
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /uploads/
